meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 技能启动一个本地网页仪表盘,用来展示代码库的知识图谱。它会检查项目中是否存在图谱数据文件;若缺失,会提示先运行 /understand 生成。随后启动开发服务器,并给出带访问令牌的网址供用户打开。
howto.when: 当用户要求启动仪表盘、查看当前项目的知识图谱可视化,或调用 /understand-dashboard 命令时触发。也支持传入项目路径,否则使用当前目录。

say.note: 它会打开当前项目的知识图谱可视化页面。

say.text: 为这个项目打开知识图谱面板
say.note: 若没有图谱数据,会提示先运行 /understand。

say.text: 展示当前代码库的知识图谱
say.note: 会启动本地服务器并分享带 token 的链接。

howto.what_en: Launches a local web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph. It checks for the project's knowledge-graph data file; if missing, it asks the user to run /understand first. It then starts a development server and provides a tokenized URL for the user to open.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to launch the dashboard, view the project's knowledge graph visualization, or invokes the /understand-dashboard command. A project path may be passed; otherwise the current working directory is used.

say_en.note: It opens the visualization for the current project's knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Open the knowledge graph panel for this project
say_en.note: If no graph data exists, it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Show the knowledge graph of the current codebase
say_en.note: It starts a local server and shares a tokenized link.
